commits.headline: fix(round-57): require manifest membership for SKILL.md, source.json, declared bins/resources
commits.body:
Round-57 codex review found that verifyInstalledIntegrity only walked
keys present in the unsigned manifest's `files` map. A local tamperer
who deletes the SKILL.md (or bin/setup) entry from .autovault-manifest
and mutates the corresponding file would slip past the integrity loop
entirely — the deleted key was never iterated, so the per-file
signature check never ran. With .autovault-source.json still bound,
check_updates would falsely greenlight the compromised install.

unsigned source.json data once the manifest became canonical, which
version-skew-broke every pre-v1 install on upgrade. Legitimate
installs created by main (detached .autovault-signature + unsigned
.autovault-source.json + no manifest) would surface as "Source
metadata signature invalid" with no migration path.
